findings.message: Marketing-verb inflation; state the machine-experience benefit plainly
findings.context: Accessibility is a clear strength on https://www.dkd.de, scoring 100/100 and ensuring all users can interact with content without barriers.

findings.description: Priority 1: Image Alt-text Coverage recommendation is generic – it advises adding alt text but does not reference specific image selectors, page URLs or counts from the audit.
Priority 2: Heading Hierarchy Skips Levels recommendation lacks a data anchor; it simply instructs to order headings without specifying which heading tags or pages are affected.

Priority 3: Semantic Structure (Naked Containers) recommendation is broad – it calls for replacing landmark containers and adding meaningful class names but does not point to the specific div selectors, page URLs or counts identified in the audit.

Priority 4: Slow Origin Response recommendation provides only high‑level guidance (profile route, cache) without referencing the exact slow URL, response time metrics or server configuration details from the audit.
Priority 5: Security headers absent – X-Frame-Options recommendation is generic; it instructs to add the header site‑wide but does not cite the specific missing header instances or page URLs.

Priority 6: Structured Data Property Gaps recommendation lacks a data anchor; it advises adding required properties generically without naming the affected WebSite entity, property names or page URLs.
Priority 7: Schema.org coverage is partial – recommendation repeats the same generic advice to add missing properties but does not reference specific schema types, properties or pages from the audit.

Priority 8: No llms.txt published recommendation is broad; it suggests publishing a file at the root without specifying the exact path, content format or referencing the audit’s discovery‑file findings.
